name: Carlos Menditeguy
features: handsome patrician face, dark hair, tanned skin, athletic sporting build, careless confident smile
bio: An international-class polo player who raced Grands Prix on the side, and one of the fastest men in Argentina over a single lap. Third at Buenos Aires in 1957 in a Maserati. Brilliant and profligate in equal measure — he broke as many cars as he beat.
